title: Senior Manager Software Engineering
description:
Cat Digital seeks a seasoned Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the Helios Platform Services India Team , building and scaling core platform capabilities that power Caterpillars digital ecosystem. This senior leadership role combines people leadership, technical direction, and product strategy . You will drive delivery and evolution of enterprise-grade capabilities that help product teams move faster through reusable, secure, and scalable services. You will partner with global engineering, product, architecture, and business leaders to accelerate Helios adoption and strengthen a reusable, API-driven engineering culture . Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership and Delivery Lead multiple teams delivering domain and core services on Helios, Caterpillars largest data platform. Drive end-to-end delivery across design, development, deployment, and operations. Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade standards for scalability, reliability, and performance. Own delivery commitments, roadmaps, and execution for the India-based teams. Platform Strategy and Architecture Partner with product, architecture, and principal engineering leaders to define the Helios roadmap . Drive adoption of cloud-native architecture patterns , including microservices, APIs, and event-driven systems. Ensure services are built as reusable, standardized components aligned with design principles. Align platform services with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements. People Leadership and Organization Building Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams, including engineering managers and senior engineers . Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline. Lead hiring, talent development, and performance management in line with Cat Digital standards. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and engineering excellence . Operational Excellence and Quality Own platform reliability, availability, and operational health, including SLA/SLO adherence, observability, and incident management. Drive adoption of DevOps, CI/CD, and automated quality practices , including TDD and BDD. Institutionalize metrics-driven engineering across quality, velocity, stability, and customer impact. Platform Adoption and Stakeholder Management Partner with product teams to accelerate onboarding and adoption. Partner with global stakeholders to prioritize platform investments and resolve cross-team dependencies. Act as a key bridge between India engineering teams and global Helios leadership. Innovation and Continuous Improvement Drive innovation in platform capabilities, including automation, AI enablement, and developer experience improvements . Identify opportunities to modernize legacy systems and improve operational efficiency. Champion a product mindset , with APIs treated as products and services owned across their lifecycle. Required Qualifications 18+ years of experience in software engineering with significant exposure to platform or enterprise-scale systems 8+ years in engineering leadership roles managing multiple teams and managers Strong experience building and operating cloud-native platforms (AWS) Proven track record delivering shared services and platform services used by multiple products Deep understanding of Java, Spring Boot , microservices, APIs, distributed systems, DevOps, CI/CD, and automation. Experience leading large-scale, globally distributed teams . Strong understanding of AI models and their use in improving developer and business outcomes. Ability to normalize and contextualize data from diverse sources for real-time decision-making. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment. Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, guide architectural decisions, and align engineering execution with business goals. Strong organizational design and talent development skills, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management. What You Will Bring Strong strategic thinking with a bias for execution. Ability to operate at both the system and organizational levels. A platform-first mindset centered on reuse, consistency, and developer experience. Executive presence and the ability to influence across functions. Passion for building teams, leaders, and long-term engineering capability in India Success Measures Increase adoption and usage across products. Improve platform reliability, scalability, and developer experience. Build a strong engineering culture and leadership pipeline. Deliver the platform roadmap and business outcomes predictably. Why This Role Matters Helios is the foundation of Caterpillars digital ecosystem , enabling reusable services, cross-product integration, and enterprise-scale innovation. This role is central to scaling the India team into a strategic execution engine for global priorities.

- Develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of modern web applications using React, TypeScript, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
- Build scalable APIs, integrations, and data-driven applications using modern engineering practices.
- Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery velocity.
- Support the integration of AI capabilities, including LLMs, Generative AI services, AI agents, and intelligent automation features, into existing and new business applications.
- Contribute to the development, integration, testing, deployment, and support of AI-enabled solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent search, conversational experiences, and workflow automation capabilities.
- Assist with the implementation and operationalization of agentic AI solutions, including prompt engineering, tool integration, vector search, and orchestration frameworks under the guidance of senior technical leaders.
- Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver scalable end-to-end solutions supporting reporting, analytics, dashboarding, and business process automation initiatives.
- Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Apply Agile and Lean development practices to deliver features and enhancements within established timelines and quality standards.
- Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement activities to promote engineering excellence and software quality.
- Build and support cloud-native solutions utilizing Azure services, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and related platform capabilities.
- Support CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code initiatives, containerized deployments, and DevOps practices utilizing GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
- Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
- Monitor and support production applications while meeting operational, reliability, and service-level objectives.
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global teams to deliver business value and technical solutions.
- Continuously learn and apply emerging AI, cloud, and software engineering technologies to improve team effectiveness and accelerate solution delivery.
 Qualifications Graduate degree or equivalent experience.
Required Qualifications
•Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
•7+ years of experience with Agile/Lean software development practices.
•4+ years of experience with cloud environments and architecture, preferably Azure.
•Experience automating CI/CD pipelines and working with source control systems such as Git and GitHub.
•Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, SQL databases, and modern web application development.
•Strong experience developing applications and services using Python and modern API development practices.
•Experience building and supporting scalable, secure enterprise-grade applications using modern architecture patterns, microservices, and service-oriented architectures.
•Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application deployment practices.
•Experience building infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
•Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, testing, documentation, and development velocity.
•Some hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying applications that integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI services, AI agents, or intelligent automation capabilities.
•Familiarity with AI application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, vector databases, semantic search, conversational AI, or knowledge-grounded AI solutions.
•Experience consuming and integrating AI platform capabilities such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, and related Azure services.
•Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
•Familiarity with Modular Agent Design: Leverage standards like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to define reusable, secure, and composable tool interfaces
•Ability to contribute to the development, deployment, and support of agentic AI solutions under the guidance of senior technical leaders.
•Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional and global teams.
•Experience participating in code reviews, technical design discussions, and engineering best practices.
 Preferred Qualifications

title: SAP Fiori ,ABAP-Sr Application Developer - 11257
description:
Job Summary Job Title: Sr Application Developer - SAP Fiori ABAP. Experience: 8+ yrs exp. Location: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad. Role Type: Permanent. Work Mode: Hybrid. Shift: 2 PM-11 PM IST. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system's bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration. Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports. Develop enhancements using released extension points BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements. Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns. Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support. Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate. Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review and document objects so client IT can maintain them. Hands-on batch management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior. Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program's largest over-customization risk. Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split. Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents. Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them. Interfaces that carry batch identity SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA. Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs). Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications. SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration. Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage. SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents. Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output. Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage). Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud. SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management. ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP. SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement Language Requirement: Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required. Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. Engagement Details Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams. Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role Clean-core development discipline CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration. SAP BTP Integration Suite Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer. Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support. Batch and lot data expertise batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. Workshops: Support and co-facilitate requirement and design workshops alongside the onsite counterpart; independently run technical deep-dive sessions where required. Team leadership: Set development standards, review the work of supporting developers, and coordinate across onsite/offshore team members. Minimum two full-cycle HAM and/or SAM Pro implementations delivered end-to-end (design through hypercare). Candidates must be able to walk through these engagements in detail scope, architecture, key design decisions, integration landscape, and lessons learned. Strong platform architecture and development depth: scoped applications, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, ACL/security model, performance considerations, and instance hygiene. CMDB/ITOM working knowledge: CSDM, Discovery data flows, and reconciliation able to design HAM/SAM on top of a mature, live CMDB. Proven ability to lead independently: facilitate workshops, defend design positions, and manage customer technical stakeholders with minimal supervision. Strong verbal and written English, comfortable presenting to customer architects and program leadership. Certifications Required: ServiceNow CSA; CISHAM and CISSAM (at least one; both strongly preferred). Preferred: CAD (Certified Application Developer), CISDiscovery or CISITSM; certifications current on recent platform releases. NICE TO HAVE Experience delivering ITAM in financial services or public sector environments (audit/regulatory-driven SAM, vendor audits, true-ups). Exposure to SaaS License Management / license optimization initiatives. Familiarity with procurement/ERP integration patterns for asset intake. App Engine / custom scoped application delivery experience. Candidate Assessment Shortlisted candidates will undergo a scenario-based technical assessment and should expect to: 1. Present a prior HAM/SAM implementation architecture, design decisions, integration landscape, and outcomes. 2. Respond to live design scenarios e.g., assetCI reconciliation conflicts, license position discrepancies, normalization gaps. 3. Demonstrate hands-on familiarity with SAM Pro reconciliation and HAM lifecycle configuration in a guided technical discussion. Only candidates who can independently articulate and defend design decisions at this stage will be progressed.

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively. Good communication skills and eagerness to work with stakeholders. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for assigned tasks. Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to process transformation.

Our culture is built on: Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. Career Development and Global Exposure 
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. If you re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we d love to hear from you. The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. This role involves developing PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, and industrial communication solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout the complete project lifecycle-from concept and design through commissioning and customer support. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms. Essential duties and responsibilities: Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning. Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software. Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices. Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation. Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support. Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
